reply.text:
That sounds like something a doctor needs to look at today, not something I can judge from here. Drooping on one side of the face together with arm weakness is a symptom I won't assess, and if it's coming on suddenly or getting worse, please call your local emergency number now rather than waiting.

Once you've been checked and a doctor or physio has cleared you, tell me what they said and I'll train around whatever they clear. Until then, I'd hold off on training.
